title: Overlapping Bimodal Cloud (Unidentifiable Components) (Legacy Prior Cohort)
intuition: Historical pre-refactor comparison cohort of `vector_overlap` retained under its original prior ownership contract so legacy baselines stay strictly separated from `recipe_owned_v1` tasks. Two broad overlapping Gaussians at (-0.35, 0) and (+0.35, 0) (sigma=0.55) where component labels are not identifiable. Grades observable global mean, global covariance, and sliced W1 over a sustained terminal window.
failure_mode: Recipes that over-segment continuous overlapping clouds into rigid discrete blobs or oscillate across late updates miss the sustained covariance and sw1 gates.
protocol_notes: Retained legacy diagnostic cohort for `vector_overlap` before the recipe-owned prior refactor; cannot substitute for current ordinary qualification cells.
